title: Thursday backyard strength
subtitle: ~25 min · backyard · upper body, core, optional jump rope
feeling: Ran about 29 minutes this morning and felt good. First weights since Monday, so I'm easing in.
note: Moderate effort, about 6 out of 10, and stop each set with 3 reps left. Your legs already ran today, so this is mostly upper body and core. Dress in layers and warm up before you start. Skip the jump rope if your legs are tired.

items.name: Arm circles, band pull-aparts, hip circles
items.cue: Get your shoulders and hips warm, especially in the cold.

sections.label: 2 · Circuit · 3 rounds
sections.instructions: Do all 4 moves in a row with no rest between them. Rest 30 seconds after the last move. Repeat 3 times.

items.name: Push-up
items.cue: Knees down on the mat is fine. Chest nearly to the floor.

items.name: One-arm row
items.cue: One 15-20 lb dumbbell. Free hand on a chair or your knee. Pull your elbow to your hip.

items.name: Shoulder press
items.cue: A 10-15 lb dumbbell in each hand. Press straight overhead.

items.name: Band pull-apart
items.cue: Hold the band in front of you at chest height. Pull it apart by squeezing your shoulder blades together.

sections.label: 3 · Core · 2 rounds
sections.instructions: Do all 3 moves in a row on the mat. Rest 20 seconds. Repeat 2 times.

items.name: Reverse crunch
items.cue: Lie on your back. Bring your knees to your chest and lift your hips a little. Lower slowly.

items.name: Dead bug
items.cue: On your back, arms up and knees bent at 90 degrees. Lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor. Keep your lower back pressed down.

items.name: Toe taps
items.cue: On your back, legs bent at 90 degrees. Lower one foot to tap the floor, then switch.

sections.label: 4 · Optional jump rope
sections.instructions: 30 seconds jumping, 30 seconds rest, 4 times. Skip it if your legs are tired.

items.name: Jump rope
items.cue: Small hops, light on your toes. Slow down instead of stopping if you get tired.

items.name: Stretch and slow breathing
items.cue: Stretch chest, shoulders, hips and calves. Breathe in through your nose, out slowly through your mouth.
